constraints.description: Every bounded plan and OpenSpec acceptance criterion maps to reproducible current evidence.
The example reuses canonical A2A and official A2UI package runtime ownership rather than implementing a parallel protocol engine.

validation.validation_method: source ownership inspection and both package export-ledger commands

constraints.description: Untrusted components and actions cannot bypass schema validation, catalog allowlisting, tenant authorization, or human approval.
Components consume hooks, command stores own graph mutation, and lists retain IDs while list/detail views react to one canonical entity.

validation.validation_method: architecture regression and browser cross-view receipt

constraints.description: Deterministic fixtures and runtime evidence cover keyless streaming, artifact render, happy and denied actions, malformed rejection, approval, and cancellation.

validation.validation_method: 10 focused units, 3 production-browser flows, and golden fixture hashes

constraints.description: All retained machine evidence parses, required artifacts exist, ten recorded hashes match, and accessibility has no serious or critical findings.

validation.validation_method: JSON parsing, file checks, SHA-256 recomputation, and receipt assertions

constraints.description: Coverage, package export ledgers, skills, documentation, and OpenSpec agree on the implemented source-workspace example.

validation.validation_method: coverage, ledger, path, and strict OpenSpec validators

constraints.description: QA must not claim packed consumption, live external-agent hosting, non-Chromium or native certification, npm publication, or inclusion in the frozen React RC candidate.

global_rules: Use current repository evidence as authoritative.
Do not infer a passing external or platform gate from source-workspace evidence.
Do not mutate npm or any other public release state.
Lead reflection with gaps and deltas rather than success claims.
termination_conditions: Both manifest variants exist and are non-empty.
Manifest, constraints, and state are internally consistent.
No material correction remains before isolated adversarial review.
